XCTL/LINK to EL005, EL010, EL626, EL001, EL004 (CICS program control)
SC-COMM-LENGTH PIC S9(4) VALUE +144 COMP (CICS commarea length field)

purpose.domain_detail: Account billing / statement display for an insurance or healthcare billing system (ERBILL file, ELCNTL file, carrier/group/account structure, credit and claims authorization codes)
purpose.summary: EL6401 is a CICS online transaction program (transaction EXC2) that handles account billing statement display. It reads ERBILL and ELCNTL VSAM files, performs security checking, and displays billing/statement information on a BMS map. It was authored by Logic, Inc. of Dallas, TX and converted from an earlier COBOL dialect in 1996.

notable_features: EXEC CICS (BMS maps, XCTL, LINK, program control)
Date conversion routine (ELDATCV) with extensive option codes including Y2K handling
Security control area with credit and claims authorization arrays
ERBILL and ELCNTL VSAM file access
87 GOTO statements indicating older structured style
Change log with dated change requests (CR2011120900003, CR2021021600001)
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 3941 lines. Copybooks were inlined at conversion time rather than using COPY statements (copy_count=0). The program_ids list includes '00689' and 'PIC' as false positives from the mechanical parser. Decoded as latin-1. Max line length exactly 72 confirms fixed-format columns 7-72.
